title.zh: 回归与相关 · 散点云里拉一条最贴的线
title.en: Regression & Correlation · The Best Line Through a Cloud

desc.zh: 一堆点，一条线，一个数：相关系数 r 说“多贴”，最小二乘线说“怎么贴最好”，还有几个让人上当的陷阱。
desc.en: A cloud of points, a line and a number: the correlation r says how tightly they follow, the least-squares line says how best to fit them, and a few traps that fool people.
